en.topic_title: Police officer fined HK$8,000 for dangerous driving as doctors unable to link woman’s death to crash
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong police officer has been fined HK$8,000 and had his driving licence suspended for 15 months for dangerous driving over a car crash last Christmas. However, a court heard on Wednesday that doctors could not determine whether the collision had caused a woman’s death.



Eastern Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP.
